rationale: SNY has already gapped up 7.6% and is trading at 92% of its intraday range near the session high, with the last five 1-minute candles showing decelerating momentum and shrinking range — the easy directional move from the gap appears largely exhausted. The ATR is very small ($0.09) relative to the gap magnitude, making it difficult to define a favorable risk/reward entry in either direction without an extremely tight stop that would be easily triggered by normal noise. With 148 minutes remaining and no clear technical setup offering asymmetric opportunity, the prudent action is to stand aside.
